dialogues.jp: 前から送られてきた白いプリントを受けとる。
dialogues.en: I stared at the white sheet in front of me.
dialogues.text: I stared at the white sheet in front of me.

dialogues.jp:
裏返したまま机の上におき、チャイムが鳴るの
を待つ。
dialogues.en:
It was placed upside-down, just waiting for the chime for me
to turn it around.
dialogues.text:
It was placed upside-down, just waiting for the chime for me
to turn it around.

dialogues.jp: キーンコーンカーンコーン
暦先生の合図と同時に、プリントを表にする。
dialogues.en:
At Koyomi-sensei's signal, the class turned over their exam
papers.
dialogues.text:
At Koyomi-sensei's signal, the class turned over their exam
papers.

dialogues.jp: 今回は現国のテストだ。
dialogues.en: Today is the social studies exam.
dialogues.text: Today is the social studies exam.

dialogues.jp: 小細工抜きに、問題用紙の頭から解いていく。
dialogues.en: I prep my brain to get ready for the questions...
dialogues.text: I prep my brain to get ready for the questions...

dialogues.jp: （“呉越　舟”の空白部分の文字は……か）
dialogues.en: "(Fill in the blank... "Bitter enemies in the ____ boat")"
dialogues.text: "(Fill in the blank... "Bitter enemies in the ____ boat")"

dialogues.en: "(Next is...oh, the same type of question...)"
dialogues.text: "(Next is...oh, the same type of question...)"

dialogues.jp: （“　肉強食”の空白部分の文字は？）
dialogues.en: "(Fill in the blank... "The strong prey on the ____")"
dialogues.text: "(Fill in the blank... "The strong prey on the ____")"

dialogues.jp: （“棚から”に続く言葉を選べ……か）
dialogues.en:
"(Continue the following phrase... "Your shelves are filled
with"...)"
dialogues.text:
"(Continue the following phrase... "Your shelves are filled
with"...)"

dialogues.en: "(Continue the following phrase... "Rolling on the Floor")"
dialogues.text: "(Continue the following phrase... "Rolling on the Floor")"

dialogues.en: "(Use your intuition to answer the following question...)"
dialogues.text: "(Use your intuition to answer the following question...)"

dialogues.jp: キーンコーンカーンコーン
なんとかギリギリ間に合ったかな……。

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「よし、じゃあ後ろから集めて」
dialogues.en: "Okay, I'd come around to collect the papers now."
dialogues.text: "Okay, I'd come around to collect the papers now."

dialogues.jp:
俺は自分の答案用紙を前にまわし、机に突っ伏
した……。
dialogues.en:
I put my exam answer sheet on my deks in front of me, then
fall back on my chair...
dialogues.text:
I put my exam answer sheet on my deks in front of me, then
fall back on my chair...

dialogues.jp:
現国の試験がきた。小細工抜きの、真剣勝負。
いい点取って、あの娘のハートもゲットだぜ。
dialogues.en:
The social studies exam had arrived. A true test of my
trickery. If I can get a good score, I bet I'd impress that
girl...
dialogues.text:
The social studies exam had arrived. A true test of my
trickery. If I can get a good score, I bet I'd impress that
girl...

dialogues.jp: ――とかなら、もう少しがんばれるんだけど。
dialogues.en: --So I'd work just a bit harder.
dialogues.text: --So I'd work just a bit harder.
